Name: Dayton Ducted Evaporative Cooler,4800 cfm,1/2HP 4rnp4, Beige
Natural: Enjoy your time indoors when the weather warms up outdoors with the DAYTON Evaporative Cooler 4RNP4. It is made with a strong 1/2-HP motor for reliability and top performance. This ducted evaporative cooler is robust enough to maintain a comfortable temperature in a space up to 1,400 sq ft in size. The unit has a water capacity of 15 gal, and there are two speed settings to adjust to your needs. This 4,800 CFM evaporative cooler includes a side discharge. Color: Off-White. Gender: male.
